**Files changed**
- `crates/sniff-css-diff/src/error.rs`: added `DiffError::SummaryDigest` with the actionable message `summary snapshot is not valid input for check/diff; recapture with --output jsonl`.
- `crates/sniff-css-diff/src/model.rs`: `load_str` (shared by `load_file`, `load_str_doc`, `load_file_doc`, hence CLI and MCP) now detects summary shape — curated `css` without `styles`, or summary-only `visible`/`grade`, recursively including tree children — and rejects it only when no `__meta.schema` is present. Mixed-layout detection is deferred so the actionable digest error wins. Full v1/v2 and empty/global-only documents are unaffected. Added loader tests for file/string/doc paths, nested children, no-`css` digests, v1 promotion, v2 acceptance, empty input, and error precedence.
- `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs` and `diff.rs`: map `SummaryDigest` to `AppError::invalid` (exit 2) instead of the default I/O mapping (exit 5), for file, `-` stdin, implicit pipe, `--params` and `--batch` inputs. Diff prefixes the message with `BASE:`/`HEAD:`.
- `crates/sniff-css/tests/check_cli.rs` and `diff_cli.rs`: CLI tests for exit 2 + message on summary file and stdin input; acceptance tests for full v1/v2 via file and stdin.

No build/test/lint run per contract; central verification still needed.
